howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image. The tool shows the current dimensions.

howto.name: Choose the scale
howto.text: Select 2x (double) or 4x (quadruple) enlargement. The tool uses Lanczos resampling for sharp, artifact-free results.

howto.name: Download the upscaled image
howto.text: Click Upscale. The enlarged image downloads in the same format as the original with the scale factor in the filename.

faq.a: The tool uses Lanczos resampling, a high-quality interpolation algorithm that produces sharp, artifact-free results. Choose 2x or 4x enlargement.
JPG, PNG, and WebP images are supported. The output format matches the input — upload a JPG, get a JPG back.

faq.q: Is there a maximum image size?
faq.a: The upscaled result cannot exceed 100 megapixels. For a 4x upscale, this means input images up to about 2500x2500 pixels.
